name: The Incident
storyline:
You thought the past was a memory to cherish... But they have been waiting for another pry to awaken...

You’re Jack Codfield, a private investigator chasing the truth behind a case long left to rot — four missing children, a vanished employees, and a family diner with a history too strange to ignore.

They said it was just a rumor. They said the place was shut down. But they didn’t say why.

A flashbacks of old employees cuts out the timeline and rewinding itself back into a strange events on what happened to them.

Now, decades later, you're stepping inside — with nothing but a flashlight, a stack of corrupted audio logs, and a creeping feeling that something’s still in there.

The mascots were made to entertain. But after dark, they don’t follow the script.

No cameras in the hallway helps on the other end of the line, two’s coming for you.

This isn’t just another missing person case. It’s what happens when you dig too deep into the past—and believe me, the past isn’t hesitant to respond.

Roam around

Listen closely

Watch the vents

Flash the hallway

Hide

So, whatever you do,

don’t let him figure it out.
summary:
This content shares the combination of Five Nights At Freddy's 2-3-4.

Also this game has point and click free roaming features,

The game features a flashlight, door, Sounds, vent lock, locker mechanics...
